service.method: SELECT MANAGER_ID AS EMPCD, 'COOPERATION' AS APPTYPE FROM SSIPD_SEAL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT MANAGER_POSITION AS EMPCD, 'APPROVAL' AS APPTYPE FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND USER_ID = ${session.ID} UNION ALL SELECT SEAL_MG_USER_ID AS EMPCD, 'DISTRIBUTE' AS APPTYPE FROM SSEAL WHERE SUBJECT ='사용인감(1)' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT SIAD.SUBJECT AS SUBJECT , SIAD.EXPLANATION AS EXPLANATION , poaseal_one.GETCODETEXT('004', 'SL003', SIAD.RE_FLAG, 'KO') AS RE_FLAG , UDGL.SUBJECT AS REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE , SIAD.SUBMISSION_PLACE AS SUBMISSION_PLACE , SIAD.REMARK AS REMARK FROM SSIAD SIAD JOIN sudgl UDGL ON UDGL.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.house_code AND UDGL.COMPANY_CODE = SIAD.company_code AND UDGL.USE_NUMBER = SIAD.REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE WHERE SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SIAD.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} ORDER BY SIAD.SMR_NUMBER DESC

SELECT poaseal_one.GETCODETEXT('004', 'SM001', SIPD.SEAL_TYPE, 'KO') AS SEAL_TYPE , SEAL.SUBJECT AS SEAL_MG_SUBJECT , SIPD.SUBJECT AS SUBJECT , SIPD.DOWN_COUNT AS COUNT , SIPD.REAL_ATTACH_NO AS ATTACH_NO FROM SSIPD SIPD JOIN SSIPD_SEAL SIPD_SEAL ON SIPD_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = SIPD.HOUSE_CODE AND SIPD_SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = SIPD.COMPANY_CODE AND SIPD_SEAL.SMR_NUMBER = SIPD.SMR_NUMBER AND SIPD_SEAL.SMD_NUMBER = SIPD.SMD_NUMBER JOIN SSEAL SEAL ON SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = SIPD.HOUSE_CODE AND SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = SIPD.COMPANY_CODE AND SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER = SIPD_SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER WHERE SIPD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIPD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SIPD.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER}

SELECT SRAD.SUBJECT AS SMI_NUMBER , CASE WHEN SISD.REAL_DOC_CHK = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS REAL_DOC_CHK , SISD.CONTENTS AS CONTENTS , SISD.COUNT AS COUNT FROM SSISD SISD JOIN SSRAD SRAD ON SRAD.HOUSE_CODE = SISD.HOUSE_CODE AND SRAD.COMPANY_CODE = SISD.COMPANY_CODE AND SRAD.SMI_NUMBER = SISD.SMI_NUMBER WHERE SISD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SISD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SISD.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER}

SELECT FI.FILE_NAME_CLIENT , FI.FILE_NAME_SERVER , FI.LAYER FROM SFMFI FI JOIN SSIPD PD ON FI.HOUSE_CODE = PD.HOUSE_CODE AND FI.COMPANY_CODE = PD.COMPANY_CODE AND FI.DOC_NUMBER = CONCAT(PD.SMR_NUMBER, '_', PD.SMD_NUMBER) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(PD.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' WHERE FI.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND FI.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND FI.DOC_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT(${SMR_NUMBER}, '%')

SELECT SETL.SUBJECT AS SUBJECT , SETL.SUBMISSION_PLACE AS SUBMISSION_PLACE , SETL.REMARK AS REMARK , SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE AS EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE , SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME AS EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME , SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE AS EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE , SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME AS EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME , UDGL.SUBJECT AS REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE FROM SSETL SETL JOIN SUDGL UDGL ON UDGL.HOUSE_CODE = SETL.HOUSE_CODE AND UDGL.COMPANY_CODE = SETL.COMPANY_CODE AND UDGL.USE_NUMBER = SETL.SEAL_USE_TYPE WHERE SETL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SETL.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER}

SELECT poaseal_one.GETUSERNAME('004','1000',SEDC_SEAL.MANAGER_ID,'KO') AS MANAGER_NAME , SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER , SEAL.SUBJECT AS SEAL_MG_SUBJECT , SEDC.SUBJECT AS SUBJECT FROM SSEDC SEDC JOIN SSEDC_SEAL SEDC_SEAL ON SEDC.HOUSE_CODE = SEDC_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND SEDC.COMPANY_CODE = SEDC_SEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND SEDC.SMR_NUMBER = SEDC_SEAL.SMR_NUMBER AND SEDC.SMD_NUMBER = SEDC_SEAL.SMD_NUMBER AND SEDC.MANAGE_NUMBER = SEDC_SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER JOIN SSEAL SEAL ON SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = SEDC.HOUSE_CODE AND SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = SEDC.COMPANY_CODE AND SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER = SEDC_SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER WHERE SEDC.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SEDC.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SEDC.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER}
SELECT DOC_NO ,DOC_SEQ ,TYPE ,DES_FILE_NAME ,SRC_FILE_NAME ,FILE_SIZE FROM SFILE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DOC_NO IN ($INS{DOC_VALUE}) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
